job: Review a proposal for a person's profile written for other people's agents
scope: The proposal, the demo, and five web searches. Verdict, strongest part, three holes, errors, what to build instead.
method: Read the proposal cold. Checked its claims with searches (IETF preference signals, Web Bot Auth, Microsoft Copilot briefing). Ranked holes by what would kill it first.
agent_note: The demo's fetch trace was hard-coded strings; the profile never left the page. I said so.
next_agent: Say the narrow true thing, not the big false one: LinkedIn has no incentive to route paid work elsewhere; it can copy a toggle in an afternoon.
